top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no written feeding instructions for the infant in care.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Affidavit (26 TAC §747.1207(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers do not have to review  a notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment form.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - HS Diploma, Equivalent, or Coursework Completion (26 TAC §747.1207(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The assistant caregiver's file lacked the documentation for qualifications for an assistant caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has a fire extinguisher in the front room that is not securely mounted.

top_violation_types.title: Designating Director (26 TAC §746.201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not designated a qualified director.

top_violation_types.title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were sending and receiving personal text messages while caring for children.
